fields.workspace_revision: Copy only from a workspace-frame receipt whose selected revision matches the cohort and whose sourceAuthority.safeToPromote is true with requiresSnapshotRefresh false.
fields.source_revision: For each member source, sha256:<hex> of its exact raw bytes; require byte length and digest readback.
fields.inventory_manifest_digest: sha256 of stableJsonV1 over schema, repository scope, workspace_revision, sorted sourceIdentityKey/sourceRef/sourceRevision/contentDigest/byteLength rows, and sorted path+reason exclusions.
fields.evidence_digest: sha256 of stableJsonV1 over directory_path, workspace_revision, inventory_manifest_digest, sorted exact member source bindings, producer_revision, and the structural card content digest.
fields.producer_revision: sha256 of exact producer source bytes plus extraction and exclusion policy/config revisions; do not substitute current Git HEAD.
fields.embedding_representation_revision: Separate identifier binding model artifact, tokenizer, task prompt, dimensions, normalization, and encoding recipe; never use it as a source or workspace revision.

revisionContract.identityRule: A directory path is a stable locator, not a revision. Revisions bind its exact member set and derived evidence at one admitted workspace snapshot.
revisionContract.memberBindingReadback: Wired in packages/parent-atlas/src/core/knowledge/directory-enrichment-hint-v2.ts (verifyDirectoryHintReadbackV2 / verifyDirectoryHintsBatchV2) and python/atlas_compute/directory_inventory_manifest_v2.py. Cross-language readback verified 4,312/4,312 directory hints against 35,587 member raw-byte digests (defectCount=0, proposalUnboundCount=4,312).

changes.effect: Builder now reports Qdrant projection as blocked and never creates or upserts a live collection. Cached manifests are normalized to the same fail-closed status.
Direct helper calls may prepare a local JSONL payload, but a reachable Qdrant now receives no collection-create or point-upsert requests unless a future qualified v2 writer is implemented.
